jobs.descriptionText:
The Network Analyst is an intermediate level role responsible for assisting with network related activities, including network installation, maintenance, technical guidance, and security in coordination with the Citi standard.
The overall objective is to support new company setup and continue to provide network support for securities company in BAU.
Responsibilities
Be responsible for the operational support of network for Citi China securities company, which includes multiple platforms, manufacturers, and technologies.
Participates in collaborating with various internal groups and external vendors to ensure all installations meet specifications.
Provide fast response to network problems of high priority, severity, and impact, escalating as appropriate.
Act directly on incidents and tasks of greater complexity or priority assigned to the team.
Excellent interpersonal relations and communication and persuasive skills; be able to manage communication with multiple audiences during problem-solving and crisis management.
Keep up with the Citi network/infra standard, act as SME to senior stakeholders and /or other team members.
Collect business requirement and interpret to proper technical components and support business to follow proper process
Assist project team on service ensure timely project delivery
Manage vendor on proper service delivery
Support and assist regional operation team on incident handling
Communicate with relevant teams to provide frequent status updates regarding the technical issue, status of the remediation efforts, and ongoing business impact
Exchange ideas and information in a concise and clear manner
Has the ability to operate with a limited level of direct supervision.
Can exercise independence of judgement and autonomy.
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Qualifications
5-8 years of experience in a network engineer role (education/professional) with demonstrated knowledge of operational process change and improvement
CCNA or above
Experience in networks and telecommunications in large-scale environments, such as Carrier, Manufacturers, Multi-Account Global Services, or a large-scale enterprise environment.
Effective oral and written communication skills.
Effective diagnostic and analysis skills. Mature analytical and communications skills.
Ability to communicate technical concepts to a non-technical audience.
Experience in Financial Services or a broad global or complex environment preferred.
Ability to provide rapid response to problems, leading multidisciplinary teams virtually.
Ability to work with personal and virtual teams and work under pressure or for rapid resolution of critical incidents
Hands on experience on China Securities industry
Education
Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience
This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

jobs.descriptionText:
The Opportunity
The CTO team is seeking a visionary, hands-on engineering leader to design, build, and scale HSBC Agent Platform as a core capability within the Group AI Platform. This role will deliver secure, reusable and high-performance platform services that enables team across the bank to build, deploy and operate agentic and generative AI solutions consistently, overing orchestration, tool integration, memory, evaluation and governance-by-design. You’ll set the technical direction, drive reliability and adoption at scale and ensure the platform meets enterprise standard for performance, resilience, security and controls.
What You’ll Do
Define the long-term technical vision and roadmap for the Agent platform in collaboration with product management team
Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of a robust, scalable, and high-performance Agent platform
Stay at the cutting edge of AI and agent movement in the industry, and adapt the agent platform to leverage the technical evolving in the industry
Work closely with technology teams across business lines to understand their requirements and ensure the platform empowers them to build agents efficiently
Integrate agent platform as part of the Group AI Platform which spans on-premise and cloud-based infrastructure
Build and manage a high-performing global team of ML SMEs and full stack engineers, to ensure the AI capabilities are built fit for purpose with high quality
Establish engineering best practices, including continuous integration / continuous delivery pipeline workflows, automation testing framework, and monitoring systems for AI applications, and ensure continuous improvement of engineering practices
Implement observability, reliability, and performance optimizations for agent platform in production
Ensure compliance to architecture principle, technical standards, security requirements and software development life cycle controls
Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related subject area
15+ of experience in developing and implementing software solutions, with 5+ years in technical leadership roles.
Hands-on experience in design and development of agentic AI solutions
Proven and deep experience in designing, building, and delivering a large-scale Agent platform
Deep understanding of the agent paradigm, including agent planning, short-term and long-term memory, tool use, agent orchestration and agent evaluation
Experience with high code and low code agent platform
Strong experience in designing and building scalable and resilient platform
Proven ability in building and managing high performing teams of AI SME and full stack engineers
Solid hands-on development skills in programming language such as Java, Python, and CI/CD tools, automation testing, and observability
Proficiency in effective stakeholder management, and capable of effectively articulating AI capabilities, and influencing both business and technology leaders
Experience working in Agile development teams with excellent collaboration skills

jobs.descriptionText:
Location: Beijing/Shanghai/Guangzhou/Shenzhen/Chengdu/Hangzhou
Global Private Banking & Wealth
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance. HSBC Private Banking helps high net worth and ultra-high net worth clients manage, grow, and preserve their wealth for generations to come. Our network of global experts helps clients access investment opportunities around the world, plan for future with wealth and succession planning, manage their portfolio with tailored solutions, and find the right support for their philanthropy.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Establish new private banking relationships and manage existing relationships in order to grow Assets Under Management and Revenue
Monitor clients’ portfolios on a regular basis to identify additional business opportunities and revenue growth potential
Work closely with other HSBC departments, including International Wealth and P remier Banking, Corporate and Institution Banking and Global Banking and Markets, to identify cross-selling opportunities and bring all of HSBC’s relevant products and services to our clients
Leverage HSBC’s channels, network and brand to pursue business development activities with a focus on International Private Wealth clients
Ensure strict compliance with HSBC’s internal control standards, including areas of risk, regulatory compliance and financial crime compliance
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
At least 10 years ’ relationship management experience, ideally in private banking, commercial banking or investment banking sectors
Proven track record in asset gathering, asset growth and revenue generation
Excellent communication and negotiation skills
Strong focus on client servicing
Excellent understanding of financial markets and wealth management products
Attention to detail and the ability to think creatively to solve problems
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

Business:CTO Platforms (AI Platform)
Job ID
：58138
Location: Guangzhou
Why join us?
HSBC Productivity Suite is our AI-powered workspace used by 250,000 colleagues across the bank. We’re moving beyond conversational generative AI to build intelligent agents and integrations that connect colleagues with trusted enterprise knowledge, services and workflows.
You’ll join a global engineering team solving complex problems at significant scale. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how artificial intelligence is designed, governed and used across HSBC, with real influence over architecture, engineering standards and product direction.
This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who wants to progress through engineering depth, delivery and influence.
The Opportunity
Our team consists of around 50 engineers across the UK, India, Poland and China. We’re continuing to grow our engineering capability in China and are looking for a senior engineer to provide technical leadership across one or more engineering pods.
As a Senior Associate Director, you’ll operate as a senior individual contributor on complex, high-impact engineering problems central to HSBC Productivity Suite. This is not a people-management role. It’s for an engineer who is strongest in hands-on system design and coding and wants to progress towards Principal Engineer through technical leadership rather than formal line management.
You’ll spend more than half your time designing, writing, testing and shipping production software. You’ll own significant AI capabilities and integrations, help define our technical vision and roadmap, and raise engineering standards across our global team.
Principal Responsibilities
Spend more than half your time on hands-on engineering, writing, reviewing, testing and shipping production code for HSBC Productivity Suite.
Design and build production-grade generative AI capabilities and integrations, taking ownership from initial design through deployment, operation and continuous improvement.
Provide technical leadership across engineering pods, forming a clear technical vision, setting direction and breaking complex programmes of work into manageable deliveries.
Make sound technical decisions across performance, security, cost, maintainability, technical debt, failure handling, observability, rollout safety and long-term operability.
Shape technical strategy and roadmaps, influencing priorities and translating user needs and ambiguous business problems into measurable outcomes and practical engineering plans.
Drive reusable capabilities, frameworks, engineering standards and effective technology controls, including monitoring and the safe use of AI coding tools and agents across the software development lifecycle.
Raise engineering capability through pairing, design and code reviews, practical mentoring, knowledge-sharing and example-setting, without formal line-management responsibility.
Lead continuous improvement in production stability, setting measurable goals to reduce incidents and recovery times and leading from the front during production issues.
Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications
Deep, hands-on software engineering experience, with a strong record of designing, coding and operating user-facing products and distributed services at scale.
Advanced use of AI coding tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to prototype, write, test and review code safely, alongside experience building agents that improve the software development lifecycle.
Strong Python expertise and practical knowledge of modern engineering practices, including application programming interfaces, microservices, databases, containers, automated testing and continuous integration and delivery.
Hands-on experience taking artificial intelligence, machine learning and generative AI solutions from experimentation through to secure, reliable production use.
Strong practical knowledge of large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, evaluation, guardrails, observability and responsible AI.
Strong engineering judgement, with the ability to balance performance, security, cost, resilience, maintainability, technical debt and delivery pace when making complex design decisions.
Experience forming a technical vision, influencing business and engineering priorities, breaking complex work into manageable deliveries and raising standards through technical expertise rather than formal authority.
Strong ownership, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work autonomously across global and multicultural teams, explain technical trade-offs clearly and turn ambiguous problems into robust, measurable outcomes.

Provide deep technical standards and approach leadership across key platforms:
Enterprise Data Assets (EDA) and APIs for standardized data provisioning
Reference Data Services for golden source alignment and hierarchy management
Big Data and Movement technologies for ingestion, streaming, and transformation at scale
Decisioning Infrastructure including real-time feature stores and orchestration
Lead peer reviews and ensure platform consistency, reusability, and compliance with enterprise standards.
Guide development teams in implementing data pipelines, APIs, metadata-driven controls, and automated testing frameworks.
Champion DevSecOps, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code across engineering teams.
Drive the control transition to using agentic AI coding assistants.
Lead the technology Developer Experience, enabling the whole of technology to discover, understand and onboard themselves to our services.
Drive best practices in observability, performance engineering, cost optimization, and scalability in hybrid cloud environments.
Mentor senior engineers and influence technical delivery across multiple squads and geographies.
Collaborate with Architecture, Cybersecurity, CDO, and business product owners to align engineering outcomes to strategic objectives.
Represent the domain in cross-platform technology councils and architecture forums.
What You Will Need To Succeed In The Role
15+ years of hands-on experience in data platform engineering, architecture, or software development, preferably in a global financial institution or scaled enterprise.
Expertise in building large-scale data pipelines, APIs, and event-driven systems using modern frameworks and technologies (e.g., Spring, Kafka, Spark, etc).
Strong architectural understanding of data mesh, data lakehouse, and real-time, customer-facing operational & analytics platforms.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and GCP), containerisation, and IaC tools.
Deep familiarity with development tooling and automation covering modeling, observability, resilience, and , and governance patterns.
Strong track record of building reusable platform services that accelerate delivery for data consumers and AI/ML initiatives.
Experience with enterprise reference data management and integration is highly desirable.
Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage and guide both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders.

Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills
High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers

了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣
成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现

普通话及英语流利

汇丰为员工提供全面、贴心的关怀与福利，自入职第一天起，员工就可以在多样化和人性化的工作场所做出积极选择，满足自己多层次的需求。

Associate Director, Software Engineering (Knowledge & RAG Platform Engineering Lead)
jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Associate Director, Software Engineering (Knowledge & RAG Platform Engineering Lead)
.
Business: CTO Platforms (AI Platforms)
Job ID: 56078
Location: Guangzhou / Xi'an
Principal Responsibilities
Senior technical IC leadership for knowledge intelligence: Act as a hands-on senior technical expert in knowledge intelligence and knowledge management, shaping architecture, technical direction, and implementation approach for an enterprise-grade knowledge platform.
Knowledge platform architecture & delivery ownership: Lead the design and build of scalable platform capabilities across ingestion, extraction, enrichment, classification, knowledge asset management, discovery, reuse, governance, and controlled downstream consumption.
Industry best practice adoption & engineering standards: Evaluate knowledge management, knowledge engineering, ontology/taxonomy, graph, and AI-assisted curation practices, and translate them into engineering standards, reusable patterns, reference architectures, APIs/SDKs, and runbooks.
Knowledge refinement & intelligence workflows: Lead workflows that extract, refine, summarize, classify, deduplicate, consolidate, and contextualize fragmented information into trusted, structured, traceable, and business-aligned knowledge assets.
Knowledge graph & semantic layer leadership: Architect and evolve ontology/taxonomy management, entity/relation extraction, entity resolution, graph modeling, graph traversal, lineage-aware context assembly, and graph-based reasoning support for AI and search scenarios.
Knowledge lifecycle, governance & self-checking: Establish mechanisms for ownership, validation, versioning, publishing, freshness monitoring, deprecation, retention, rollback, quality scoring, duplication/contradiction detection, and citation/provenance validation.
Optimisation & operational readiness: Define SLOs/SLAs, observability, alerting, capacity planning, cost controls, incident response, troubleshooting playbooks, resilience patterns, and continuous production improvement for knowledge platform services.
Cross-team influence & enablement: Partner with AI engineering, data platforms, cybersecurity, architecture, product, and domain SMEs to drive adoption, mentor engineers, review designs, unblock complex issues, and communicate trade-offs to senior stakeholders.
Requirements
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Management, Data Engineering, AI, or a related technical discipline; 7+ years of hands-on engineering experience in backend, data, AI, knowledge, search, or enterprise information platforms.
Proven experience as a senior technical IC or platform technical lead, owning architecture, engineering standards, design review, implementation quality, optimisation, and production readiness for complex platform capabilities.
Deep knowledge of knowledge intelligence and management practices, including taxonomy/ontology design, metadata standards, knowledge refinement, lifecycle management, governance, lineage, and enterprise content operations.
Hands-on experience with knowledge graph, semantic search, RAG, agentic AI, or data enrichment systems, plus strong engineering foundations in distributed systems, APIs, data pipelines, observability, CI/CD, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Strong security, compliance, production, and stakeholder mindset, with the ability to adopt industry best practices, mentor engineers, influence cross-functional teams, and apply AI-native approaches to improve quality, productivity, and decision-making.
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Associate Director, Software Engineering(Productivity Suite).
Business:CTO Platforms (AI Platform)
Job ID
：
58133
Location: Guangzhou
Why join us?
HSBC Productivity Suite is our AI-powered workspace used by 250,000 colleagues across the bank. We’re moving beyond conversational generative AI to build intelligent agents and integrations that connect colleagues with trusted enterprise knowledge, services and workflows.
You’ll join a global engineering team solving complex problems at significant scale. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how artificial intelligence is designed, governed and used across HSBC, with real influence over architecture, engineering standards and product direction.
The Opportunity
Our team consists of around 50 engineers across the UK, India, Poland and China. We’re growing our engineering capability in China and are looking for an experienced engineer to work as a senior technical contributor within one of our engineering pods.
As an Associate Director, Software Engineering, you’ll operate as an individual contributor, designing and delivering significant capabilities for HSBC Productivity Suite. You’ll take complex requirements from initial definition through coding, testing, release and production operation.
This is not a formal people-management role. You’ll spend most of your time on hands-on engineering while providing practical technical direction, removing delivery blockers and mentoring other engineers in the pod.
Principal Responsibilities
Spend most of your time on hands-on engineering, writing, reviewing, testing and shipping production code for HSBC Productivity Suite.
Design and deliver significant generative AI capabilities and integrations, owning delivery from requirements through to production operation.
Act as a senior engineer within an engineering pod, making sound design decisions, clarifying ambiguity and breaking complex requirements into actionable deliveries.
Build secure, resilient and maintainable services, applying appropriate engineering controls across testing, deployment, monitoring, observability and production support.
Use and improve shared frameworks, platforms and reusable capabilities, giving constructive feedback and reducing duplication and technical debt.
Promote effective engineering practices, including the safe use of AI coding tools and agents to improve quality and delivery across the software development lifecycle.
Take an active role in production incidents, helping restore service, leading reviews and ensuring lessons result in practical improvements.
Mentor engineers through pairing, design and code reviews, knowledge-sharing and practical support, while informing technical direction through evidence and engineering expertise.
Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications
Strong hands-on software engineering experience, with a record of designing, coding, testing and operating significant applications or product capabilities.
Effective use of AI coding tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to prototype, write, test and review code safely, with an interest in building agents that improve the software development lifecycle.
Strong Python expertise and practical knowledge of modern engineering practices, including application programming interfaces, microservices, databases, containers, automated testing and continuous integration and delivery.
Hands-on experience building AI, machine learning or generative AI solutions and taking them from experimentation into secure, reliable production use.
Practical knowledge of large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, evaluation, guardrails, observability and responsible AI.
Sound engineering judgement across performance, security, resilience, maintainability, accessibility, technical debt and production operability.
Ability to clarify ambiguous requirements, identify the most important parts of a problem and deliver robust solutions with limited oversight.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly, challenge constructively and mentor engineers in a global team.

jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Consultant Specialist.
Business: GTS Technology
Job ID: 65362
Principal Responsibilities
Collaborating with Product Analysts / Developer to create requisite acceptance criteria and ensure the acceptance tests reflect the desired functionality test cases as a senior QA.
Participating in evaluation of functional and non-functional requirements for testability and suitability for automation testing.
Designing, Scripting, Executing test automation scenarios and documenting test results in automation testing report.
Increasing coverage of test automation packs and pass rate in testing cycle as advised by QA Lead.
Participate in release activities and giving automation testing QA sign offs.
Working collaboratively as part of a multi-disciplinary Agile team.
Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications
Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related field.
Good understanding of software testing concepts, testing lifecycle, and defect management process.
Ability to analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and user stories to create effective test scenarios and test cases.
Hands-on experience in executing test cases, test plans for functional testing and regression testing.
Ability to work under pressure to complete tasks in tight schedule and ensure product quality.
Highly-motivated individual with positive and pro-active attitude.
Additional Skills Will Be Good To Have
Relevant product knowledge of trade is a big plus.
Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

jobs.title: Product Specialist, HSBC Qianhai (GCB 5)
jobs.descriptionText:
HSBC Qianhai
HSBC Qianhai Securities Limited (HSBC Qianhai), a joint venture securities company, was incorporated on 28 August 2017, pursuant to Supplementary Agreement X to the Closer Economic Partnership Arrangements (CEPA) between the mainland and Hong Kong.
The registered capital of HSBC Qianhai is RMB1.8 billion. The Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited (HSBC) holds 90% of the shares, while Qianhai Financial Holdings Co., Ltd. (QFH) holds the remaining 10%. Our headquarters are located in Qianhai, Shenzhen. We have branch offices in Beijing and Shanghai, and a trading outlet in Qianhai, Shenzhen.
By combining solid expertise in the domestic capital market with the global competitive advantage of the HSBC Group, we are committed to providing our customers with comprehensive securities services and a diverse range of products, aspiring to be your unique partner in China's onshore capital markets.
Our purpose – ‘Opening up a world of opportunity’ – explains why we exist. For information about our purpose and values, please visit HSBC.com.
HSBC Qianhai is part of one of the world’s largest financial services organisations. Whether you are an experienced professional, looking for your first job, or are interested in one of our student and graduate programmes, we provide many ways for you to develop your skills and achieve your career ambitions in a diverse and inclusive environment.
We offer opportunities across our organisation to build a fulfilling career and work with colleagues and customers around the world. We have roles available in business areas including Investment Banking, Securities Brokerage, Investment Advisory, Securities Proprietary Trading, Asset Management and Private Wealth Management, and Functions, Digital Business Services.
We look for people who are ambitious and want to develop their career and contribute to HSBC’s long-term, sustainable growth. We want employees who can help us achieve our strategy, balance social, environmental and economic considerations and manage risk accordingly.
To ensure we achieve this growth in the right way, we place great emphasis on our values. We are committed to applying the highest standards throughout the company, everywhere we do business.
Diversity and inclusion is at the heart of our business. Joining HSBC will give you the opportunity to work in a collegiate and supportive environment in which we seek to develop and promote you based on merit.
We also have a strong commitment to sustainability and encourage employees to participate in our community projects and other activities.
Responsibilities Of The Role Holder
Set the strategic direction of the investment and wealth solutions for clients, especially in the areas of Brokerage, Investment Advisory and Investment Banking referral
Provide investment support, education and guidance to external clients, prospects and Investment Counsellors
Develop comprehensive investment strategy and asset allocation proposal appropriate to clients, and coordinate execution with appropriate products and services
Provide input and support for the development of new business initiatives and product enhancement in the covered areas
Manage the life cycle of the onboarded products/services including authorities reporting, product/service training, performance monitoring and communication, risk and compliance issues follow up, etc.
Provide regular and timely updates on investment opportunities to clients, prospects and Investment Counsellors
Coordinate with relevant departments to complete the policy and procedure write up
Other projects or initiatives assigned by line manager
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Master Degree and/or CFA, minimum 7 years’ experience in product related role in financial institutions, and minimum 5 years’ experience in Securities houses
SAC qualifications is pre-requisite, esp Investment Advisory Qualification
Good business acumen with understanding of the Securities house’s businesses including Brokerage, Investment Advisory, Investment Banking, Asset Management, Derivatives, etc.
Extensive knowledge of wealth management business (onshore and offshore), and competitive and regulatory environment
Highly independent and a good team player
Strong analytical skill with strategic thinking ability and good project management skills
Client-focused, with strong negotiation, communication and presentation (written and oral) skills
Able to work under pressure and solve complex problems
Fluent in both English and Chinese writing and speaking

Strong ability to design and evolve complex systems with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and performance.

jobs.descriptionText:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Supporting tasks to establish new business relationships and strengthening existing ones, whilst ensuring fair outcomes for all types of customers
Providing support to the communication new products, propositions and relevant market information to customers
Supporting distribution channel business development strategies
Supporting plans and strategies to generate new business as well as increase revenue for existing ones
Collaborating with internal stakeholders, which may include relationship mangers and product specialists, to maximise cross-selling opportunities for the bank
Participating in events, initiatives and activities to develop business opportunities
Protect the bank's reputation and ensuring an acceptable risk profile, whilst deepening your understanding of the client through credit and customer due diligence reviews
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Proven ability in mobile sales / channel developing and maintaining
Current product/market knowledge
Excellent customer service skills
Managerial experience
At least 3 years’ experience in supervisory role of sales function
Excellent interpersonal, leadership and motivation skills
Strong sales and organization ability and problem solving skills
Result driven and able to work under pressure
Good spoken and written English
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Provide training sessions for key staff to uplift risk awareness

Own the risk & control agenda for region

Assist service/project owners in responding appropriately and effectively to firm-wide risk, cyber and corporate control initiatives

Provide visibility of status of action plans and external/internal audit issues

Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to convey complex risk topics to diverse audiences.

Influencing skills.
Stakeholder management.
General interest in Technology including awareness of trends.

Consult on projects, providing subject matter expertise during audits and regulatory exams.
Share best practices with the wider Risk and Control Organisation.
Support engagement with internal/external/client audit and regulatory exams, including oversight of fieldwork and remediation.
Advocate for continuous improvement in data accuracy and control effectiveness across all enterprise data repositories.

jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Senior Consultant Specialist
.
Business:
IWPB Technology
Principal Responsibilities
Work as part of Global Digital Engineering team with responsibility for API delivery
Collaborate with API Architects & Technical Platform Architects to understand& feedback for the established API best practice
Work with Global Enterprise/Solution Architects to review end-to-end technical design.
Lead engineers to work on API delivery including API development & deployment with good quality & on schedule
Review/Ensure the technical design/code structure is technically coherent and future proof and compliance with technology standards and regulatory obligations
Identify any issues that may arise to delivery risk, formulate preventive actions or corrective measures and timely escalate major project risks & issues to senior management
Provide professional consultancy/support immediately for application teams’ queries/requests.
Requirements
University Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline
Solid and proficient skills in Java, Spring Framework, Web Service, JSON, RAML
Knowledge or experience in Enterprise Integration Platform (EIP) and API design with implementation experience on any ESB tools (e.g. IIB , Kong, MQ, SpringBoot)
Knowledge and experience of DevOps, Microservice, Restful API, Agile concepts. SAFe Agilist certificate is a plus.
Knowledge of DevOps tooling such as Jenkins, Git, Ansible, Splunk, Jira/Confluence, AppD, Docker, Kubernetes
Solid knowledge of SQL, DDL and database design
Solid knowledge of BDD, Continuous Integration, Selenium, continuous deployment and testing
Solid knowledge of external cloud providers such as Amazon Web Services, or Ali Cloud
Track record in working on the delivery of complex deployment projects and under diversified/ matrix structure
Strong business sense with good understanding in how IT systems impact business objectives
Strong communication, presentation & influencing skills, able to operate well across cultures and in multi-cultural, diverse work environments
Strong analytical, design and problem solving skills
Excellent team player with ability to work under minimal supervision
Strong quality assurance capability, ensure that the project meets quality standards, implement best practices and processes for development and delivery
Good command of written and spoken English. Mandarin is also preferred
Able to work at flexible hour for late evening meeting with colleagues in various regions, API deployment & production support
Able to work under pressure
Willing to learn/explore various technologies especially in Integration domain

jobs.descriptionText:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Developing our Premier customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier clientele portfolio
Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs
Promoting our Premier Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate
Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance
扩大卓越理财客户群，并与卓越理财客户建立长期关系
根据客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富
向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门
配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证
Qualifications
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline
Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability
Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills
High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers
Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets
Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure
Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills
Fluency in Mandarin and English
本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳
具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系
具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流
以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务
了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣
成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现
具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧
普通话及英语流利
我们的福利
汇丰为员工提供全面、贴心的关怀与福利，自入职第一天起，员工就可以在多样化和人性化的工作场所做出积极选择，满足自己多层次的需求。
假期福利
除法定休假外，有年假、带薪病假、志愿者假、妇女节、休假等。您入职后即可享有10~25天的丰厚年假，让您在工作之余有充分的时间放松身心。在您生日当月，更有一天生日假，您可以和家人、朋友等一起庆祝这温馨的时刻。
全面的福利保险计划
包括定期寿险、意外伤亡险、重疾险、补充商业医疗保险等，覆盖全方位生活场景，为您的保障添砖加瓦。
员工体检
每年为您提供一次关爱体检，有多种套餐，全面评估您的身体状况和生活方式，帮助您实现健康生活、快乐工作。
弹性福利
当您考虑为家庭提供更多保障时，MyChoice员工弹性福利平台可以满足您不同人生阶段的各种需求。每年您都享有弹性福利积分，可以调整您的福利保险，买卖年假，为家人购买体检套餐等，DIY一份专属于您的福利计划。
心理健康咨询
您和您的直系亲属均可免费获得专业的心理健康咨询，包含个人成长、缓解职场压力、解决情感困惑等，助您一路“升级打怪”，稳步前进。
企业年金
汇丰企业年金这一补充养老金计划为您更添一份保障。建立企业账户和个人账户，由汇丰和您按照一定比例每月缴存。更有专业的金融机构共同运营，确保年金资金的安全独立、灵活投资，您可在退休时领取，提升您退休后的生活品质。
弹性工作
为了让大家发挥最佳表现，您有各种弹性工作的灵活选择。
PSQP专业进修计划
专业进修计划通过为员工报销学费的方式鼓励员工追求职业发展。员工可就经PSQP批核的进修计划和经批核学位列表中涵盖的专业进修享受学费报销

财务安全规划经理的活动包括客户会见、培训、辅导、客户沙龙、客户资产组合回顾及保单回顾等。

jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Consultant Specialist.
Business: GTS Technology
Job ID: 65321
Principal Responsibilities
Design, develop, and implement IT solutions using Java, Spring Boot, and JPA to meet business requirements from global markets.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and shape new functionalities.
Conduct system test, user acceptance test and provide support on system implementation.
Participate in code reviews and continuous integration to maintain code quality and support frequent, reliable releases.
Troubleshoot complex technical issues and guide teams toward practical, scalable solutions.
Contribute to production support, root-cause analysis, and ongoing service improvements.
Implement best practices and quality standards in project management and software development.
Apply design patterns to create robust and scalable software architectures.
Communicate project status, risks, and issues to senior management and stakeholders effectively.
Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and issues in solution proposals, system design, and implementation.
Leverage automation and AI-enabled tools to improve productivity across coding, testing, and migration.
Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field, with over 3 years of technology working experience.
Solid knowledge and programming skills, particularly in Java and Spring Boot.
Hands-on experience with Core Java, Maven, and RESTful API testing using tools like REST Assured and JUnit.
Strong ability to understand business processes and translate them into effective technology solutions through collaboration with business stakeholders.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
Ability to influence business for technology related decision making which supports shared goals.
Removes blockers and creates pathways during times of uncertainty to ensure resilience.
Strong ability to mentor and provide necessary subject matter expertise to the team when required.
Demonstrated ability in software design and familiarity with design patterns, and the ability to apply them effectively.
Additional Skills Will Be Good To Have
Good understanding of Agile methodologies, including Scrum or SAFe.
Ability to work in a fast-paced dynamic environment to deliver high-quality results under tight schedule and high pressure.
Stakeholder management, problem-solving skills and innovative thinking.
Experience in financial services or global trade finance is preferred.
Familiar with AI toolings (e.g., HPS, GAIP, Copilot...etc.).

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Conduct product training to support and deliver new product launches and lead client education events to help client gain better knowledge of financial markets and financial solutions.
Follow the needs-based sales process, give clients a meaningful and consistent wealth experience and ultimately provide an outstanding client experience
Support RMs to gain more client trust and commitment in broadening and deepening their relationship with HSBC, and increase the effectiveness and quality of needs fulfilled for target clients
Strengthen HSBC’s image as a leading wealth provider by providing clients with access to advanced technical product expertise
Conduct portfolio reviews with RMs, assess product suitability and market and regulatory change impact to products held by clients as appropriate, identify opportunities and manage risks
Join RMs in meeting clients and provide advice, input based on technical knowledge while acting as a second point of contact to RMs for specific products and solutions
Improve RMs product specific technical knowledge by effective on-job coaching and training
Activity: (Joint) meeting, Training, Coaching, Client Seminar, Portfolio Review, Policy Review
提供新产品培训，帮助客户获得更好的理财市场信息和解决办法。
根据客户财务需求，分享合适的财富管理经验和提供良好的客户体验
帮助客户经理获得并加深客户信任，提高满足客户财务需求的有效性和质量
利用先进的技术专长，加强客户对汇丰在财富管理市场上的领先形象
帮助客户经理梳理客户财务组合，根据市场和政策变化，判断潜在机会并管理风险，对客户持有产品进行相应调整
陪同客户经理约见客人，并基于产品和解决方法提供专业建议

jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
WPS Service Management Lead.
Business:
Wealth & Prem Solutions Tech
IWPB Technology
Job ID
：
58835
The Role
This role is accountable for governing and improving the delivery of live IT services across all WPS Value Streams and platforms. You’ll ensure services are customer-focused, resilient, compliant and consistently delivered across a complex regulated environment. Working across incident, problem, change, release, request, knowledge, continuity, supplier and service-level management you’ll set the standards that keep services running reliably. Success means clear service ownership and service measures that reflect critical customer journeys and regulatory obligations. It also means faster recovery from major incidents, fewer repeat issues and stronger operational readiness for change. You’ll translate operational performance, risks and improvement progress into business terms for senior stakeholders.
Principal Responsibilities
Own the WPS service catalogue, service model, support ownership, OLAs, supplier agreements and SLAs aligned to critical customer journeys and service hours
Run service reviews and communicate service performance, risks, actions and improvement progress in clear business language
Govern incident and major incident management including prioritisation, escalation, stakeholder communications recovery governance and follow-up
Oversee problem management by identifying trends maintaining known errors and workarounds and tracking corrective actions through to closure
Facilitate blameless post-incident reviews with SRE, engineering, operations, suppliers and business stakeholders
Govern change and release activities including assessment approval scheduling evidence implementation and rollback plans and communications
Coordinate CAB activities, the WPS release calendar, cross-team dependencies, protection periods and production-support coverage
Coordinate continuity, disaster-recovery and resilience exercises and maintain operational risks, audit actions evidence and supplier performance escalations
Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications
Bring proven IT Service Management, Production Support or Technology Operations leadership experience in a complex regulated environment
Apply strong practical knowledge of ITIL practices across incident, problem, change, release, service-level, continuity, request, knowledge and supplier management
Manage high-severity incidents and ensure timely major-incident communications across business and technology stakeholders
Define and operate SLAs, OLAs and KPIs and use them to shape service reviews and measurable service improvements
Demonstrate understanding of cloud, DevOps, Agile delivery, production operations, cybersecurity and resilience concepts
Use strong analytical, organisational and stakeholder-management skills to prioritise risks actions and improvements
Operate effectively with ITSM tooling and third-party supplier management
Hold ITIL 4 Managing Professional, ITIL Strategic Leader or equivalent certification, or bring equivalent demonstrable experience
/LP/WX

jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Head of Engineering- PE, Application Platforms.
Business:CTO
Job ID：58472
The Opportunity
CTO Platform Engineering & Architecture (CTOp), within the CTO, builds next-gen application and AI platforms that cut toil through open-source and automated controls, so teams ship code (and containers) faster, safer and more reliably.
This hands-on Head of Engineering, Principal role leads Application Platform Engineering in partnership with the Head of Application Platforms, owning outcomes end-to-end from strategy and roadmap to transparent governance and predictable delivery.
You’ll combine big-picture platform architecture with hands-on implementation to drive ~80% migration to the standard platform and consolidate six hosting platforms into one resilient, well-controlled estate, strengthening observability, operational readiness and measurable engineering standards.
What You’ll Do
Leading the engineering function for Application Platform Engineering, covering strategic direction and day-to-day execution.
Supporting the Head of Application Platforms with end-to-end ownership of delivery, controls, and outcomes across the team.
Establishing and operating effective governance, including prioritisation, delivery cadence, and decision-making forums.
Defining, implementing, and tracking measurable engineering standards to improve quality, reliability, and consistency.
Driving the migration strategy and execution to achieve ~80% application migration onto the standard platform.
Leading the consolidation of six hosting platforms into a standard platform to reduce complexity and operational risk.
Improving platform resilience and time-to-market through standard patterns, reusable capabilities, and streamlined delivery.
Ensuring consistent observability practices (monitoring, logging, alerting) across the platform and migrated applications.
Implementing automated run controls to strengthen operational management and reduce manual intervention.
Managing delivery and control outcomes, ensuring transparency through metrics, reporting, and continuous improvement.
Partnering with stakeholders across technology and delivery to align priorities, manage dependencies, and remove blockers.
What You Will Need To Succeed In The Role
We are agnostic - focused on impact and outcomes: You may come with Java, Python, Node, C, C++, C# or any other coding language.
14+ years’ relevant senior engineering leadership experience in Platform Engineering and/or large-scale application hosting environments.
Proven track record delivering complex technology change across multiple teams, including platform consolidation and migration programmes.
Strong experience establishing governance, prioritisation, and delivery management practices in an engineering-led environment.
Demonstrable ability to define and embed engineering standards with measurable outcomes (e.g., reliability, quality, delivery performance).
Strong understanding of resilience engineering, operational risk management, and controls within enterprise technology environments.
Strong knowledge of observability practices and operating models (monitoring, logging, alerting, SLOs/SLAs, incident management).
Experience implementing automation for operational controls (e.g., automated runbooks, policy-as-code, standardised controls).
Ability to drive standardisation through consistent engineering patterns and reusable platform capabilities.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across senior technology leadership and delivery partners.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to translate strategy into executable plans and clear outcomes.
Demonstrated leadership behaviours that build inclusive, high-performing teams, with clear accountability and a focus on delivery outcome.
Note that this is a hands-on role and will be a Principal Engineer, there will be an expectation that they deliver code through to production.
Ideally, you are capable of writing Linux kernel, know Kubernetes, understand networks from packets to TCP/UDP to service mesh.
/LP

jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Senior Business Analyst
.
Business:
Cybersecurity
Job ID
：
65326
Principal Responsibilities
Impact on the Business/Function
Deliver security research and testing projects focused on HSBC critical services and projects to ensure that design, quality and implementation of controls do not expose the bank to a significant level of risk.
Achieve excellence by driving performance, compliance and security.
Provide oversight and control over third party Threat-led Penetration Tests in line with the varied regional regulatory requirements and the organizations risk appetite.
Work with key stakeholders to proactively drive the reduction in Cybersecurity risks and to improve the security risk posture of HSBC within the business risk appetite.
Provide subject matter expertise and guidance to a broad range of stakeholders across global business and functions.
Customers / Stakeholders
Engage with relevant programmes that are critical to the bank.
Understand the financial services industry security and threat landscape.
Engage with a diverse set of stakeholders in order to achieve CROS objectives, including Group leadership, Business and Functions CIOs, CISOs, Cybersecurity leads and Control Owners.
Engage with specialist technology functions such as, HSBC Digital, Innovation and Technology Centres.
Leadership & Teamwork
Strong teamwork with the global CROS as well as all Global Businesses and Functions.
Establish and maintain productive relationships across the bank in the client facing role.
Leadership skills and the ability to manage vendors and staff.
Operational Effectiveness & Control
Adherence to operational controls, as outlined in procedures and policies to ensure risks are identified and managed.
Establishment of all necessary operational controls within the tools and systems used.
The jobholder will ensure the fair treatment (service excellence) of our customers is at the heart of everything we do, both personally and as an organisation.
Management Of Risk (Operational Risk / FIM Requirements)
The jobholder will also continually reassess the Cybersecurity and operational risks associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructurings, and the impact of new technology.
This will be achieved by ensuring all actions take account of the likelihood of operational risk occurring. Also, by addressing any areas of concern in conjunction with entity management and/or the appropriate department.
Requirements
Observation of Internal Controls (Compliance Policy / FIM requirements)
Maintains HSBC internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators.
The jobholder will also adhere to and be able to demonstrate adherence to internal controls. This will be achieved by adherence to all relevant procedures, keeping appropriate records and, where appropriate, by driving the timely implementation of internal and external audit points, including issues raised by external regulators, and internally identified Cybersecurity risks.
The jobholder will implement the group compliance policy by containing compliance risk in liaison with Global Head of Compliance, Global Compliance Officer, Area Compliance Officer or Local Compliance Officer. The term ‘compliance’ embraces all relevant financial services laws, rules and codes with which the business has to comply.
This will be achieved by adhering to all relevant processes/procedures and by liaising with compliance department about new business initiatives at the earliest opportunity. Also and when applicable, by ensuring adequate resources.
Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications
Education to degree level or above (Desirable) or relevant work experience
English - Fluent written and spoken
Proven written and verbal communication skills
Strong team management, leadership and team building skills.
Ability to develop clear business impact and justification to drive investment in team capabilities

 Impact on the Business/Function

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families.   • Design, develop, test and maintain reliable software applications and services.

    • Portfolio management and investment operations
    • Client onboarding and servicing
    • Portfolio reporting and performance analytics
    • Order management and trade processing
    • Risk, suitability and regulatory controls
    • Digital banking and relationship-manager tools
  • Translate business and user needs into clear technical designs and deliverable solutions.
  • Develop secure APIs, data services and user interfaces where appropriate.

  • Write clean, maintainable and well-documented code, supported by automated testing.
  • Contribute to code reviews, technical standards and engineering best practices.
  • Investigate production issues, identify root causes and implement sustainable fixes.
  • Support continuous improvement in application resilience, performance, observability and scalability.
  • Work within applicable information-security, data-protection, risk-management and change-control requirements.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across technology, asset management, private banking, operations, risk and compliance.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, planning, estimation and delivery activities.
  • Contribute to a culture of knowledge sharing, inclusion and responsible technology delivery.
Requirements

  • Professional experience in software engineering or application development.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more relevant languages, such as: Java, C++
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and working with distributed systems.
  • Good knowledge of relational databases and SQL; experience with NoSQL technologies is useful.
  • Familiarity with version control, automated testing and CI/CD practices.
  • Understanding of software-development life cycles and Agile delivery methods.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

jobs.descriptionText:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)
Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Developing our Premier customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier clientele portfolio
Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs
Promoting our Premier Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate
Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance
扩大卓越理财客户群，并与卓越理财客户建立长期关系
根据客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富
向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门
配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证
Qualifications
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
University level education, preferably in finance, business or a related discipline
Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability
Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills
High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers
Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets
Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure
Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills
Fluency in Mandarin and English
本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳
具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系
具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流
以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务
了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣
成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现
具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧
普通话及英语流利
我们的福利
汇丰为员工提供全面、贴心的关怀与福利，自入职第一天起，员工就可以在多样化和人性化的工作场所做出积极选择，满足自己多层次的需求。
假期福利
除法定休假外，有年假、带薪病假、志愿者假、妇女节、休假等。您入职后即可享有10~25天的丰厚年假，让您在工作之余有充分的时间放松身心。在您生日当月，更有一天生日假，您可以和家人、朋友等一起庆祝这温馨的时刻。
全面的福利保险计划
包括定期寿险、意外伤亡险、重疾险、补充商业医疗保险等，覆盖全方位生活场景，为您的保障添砖加瓦。
员工体检
每年为您提供一次关爱体检，有多种套餐，全面评估您的身体状况和生活方式，帮助您实现健康生活、快乐工作。
弹性福利
当您考虑为家庭提供更多保障时，MyChoice员工弹性福利平台可以满足您不同人生阶段的各种需求。每年您都享有弹性福利积分，可以调整您的福利保险，买卖年假，为家人购买体检套餐等，DIY一份专属于您的福利计划。
心理健康咨询
您和您的直系亲属均可免费获得专业的心理健康咨询，包含个人成长、缓解职场压力、解决情感困惑等，助您一路“升级打怪”，稳步前进。
企业年金
汇丰企业年金这一补充养老金计划为您更添一份保障。建立企业账户和个人账户，由汇丰和您按照一定比例每月缴存。更有专业的金融机构共同运营，确保年金资金的安全独立、灵活投资，您可在退休时领取，提升您退休后的生活品质。
弹性工作
为了让大家发挥最佳表现，您有各种弹性工作的灵活选择。
PSQP专业进修计划
专业进修计划通过为员工报销学费的方式鼓励员工追求职业发展。员工可就经PSQP批核的进修计划和经批核学位列表中涵盖的专业进修享受学费报销

jobs.descriptionText:
HSBC
Corporate and Institutional Banking(CIB)
HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Business: To maximize the revenues of customer portfolio and increase the Bank's share of customer wallets. To maintain a high level of credit quality in the jobholder's customer portfolio and to mitigate the hidden risks of the evolving Banking products.
Assist Associate Director/ Director To
 Co-ordinate origination and execution of in country activities across the spectrum of banking products/service.
 Build the Banking franchise value/reputation in the market place.
 Drive achievement against targets for revenue generation, product alignment, customer satisfaction and cost containment.
 Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk.
 Identify event driven opportunities on an opportunistic basis, bringing in sector/country expertise as appropriate.
 Aggressively grow HSBC's share of client wallet involving product specialists to ensure product capabilities are in line with client/sector requirements.
 By critically assessing the exposures of each customer through vigorous review processes, active communications with CST members and frequent update of market intelligence. Such reviews are to be completed on time as required by the account review cycle and also where deemed necessary.
 By working closely with Credit Risk Management to ensure that all credits are in compliance of both internal and external requirements and to formulate / implement exit or rehabilitation strategies for substandard credits. The primary goals are to safeguard the Bank for any material loss and to obtain an optimal balance between risk and return.
Customers and Stakeholders: To build effective customer relationships and to become the customers' preferred financial partner and trusted advisor.
 By ensuring customers' experiences with the Bank in all front exceed their expectations, i.e. first class services are provided promptly and professionally; solutions presented are competitive and innovative.
 By keeping abreast of the customer's business development through frequent contacts in both official and social occasions.
 By providing advisory-led value added services to customers with the jobholder's updated sector knowledge and market intelligence.
 To assist senior bankers in ensuring focused relationship building programs are carried out regularly.
Leadership & Teamwork: To coordinate the CST to ensure the clients' needs are covered in a proactive and efficient manner. To support the senior bankers in operational issues.
 By effectively utilizing customer relationship management tool (i.e. CME).
 By managing client meetings and ensuring that product partners actively participate in discussions concerning client requirements and needs.
 By working closely with customers to identify macro operating issues and to satisfy their requirements on a regional /local basis.
 Understand and ensure compliance with all relevant internal and external rules, regulations and procedures that apply to the conduct of the business in which the jobholder is involved.
 Maintain HSBC internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators.
 Demonstrate leadership on Regulatory & Compliance matters. Maintain awareness of operational risk and minimize the likelihood of it occurring including its identification, assessment, mitigation and control, loss identification and reporting.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Ability to provide marketing support to senior relationship managers
Ability to establish rapport with members of client's management team
Ability to provide good analytical support to senior relationship managers
Strong PC skills (excel, PowerPoint etc.)
Good team player
Knowledge of HSBC Group structures and products
Good verbal and written communication skills
Knowledge of the spectrum of banking products and services
Understanding of risk management and credit mitigants
Good level of financial analysis ability
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

IWPB Technology
Job ID
：
58258
The Role
The Engineering Lead for Lending serves as the senior technical leader on the card system frontend & backend capabilities. This role leads engineering teams to build secure, resilient, scalable customer card journeys, elevate team engineering standards, accelerate delivery, and maintain operational excellence within regulated financial services.
Principal Responsibilities
Lead, coach cross-functional frontend/backend teams; assist Head of Value Stream to set clear individual & team performance goals.
Work as the OIC when Head of Value Stream is out of office.
Assist Head of Value Stream to conduct full team lifecycle management: recruitment, onboarding, performance reviews, succession planning, and capability building.
Assist Head of Value Stream to foster a psychologically safe, accountable, inclusive team culture focused on continuous improvement.
Assist Head of Value Stream to manage team capacity planning, resource forecasting and annual people budget, balance workload across feature delivery, tech debt, and production stability.
Own the innovation of end-to-end card services: card management, spend limits, servicing, disputes/chargebacks, UIs, and supporting APIs.
Convert product priorities into structured delivery plans with scope, milestones, dependencies, and risk mitigation; align with Product, Ops, and platform teams for execution.
Ensure all systems meet strict non-functional requirements for high-volume production traffic.
Work with the architecture team to lead the solution design for the team’s web/mobile frontends and backend microservices; enforce consistent reusable design patterns.
Assist Head of Value Stream to govern the API-first development, version control, backward compatibility, and contract testing to cut integration risks.
Assist Head of Value Stream to govern the production operability: monitoring, logging, alerts, and complete runbook support for all delivered services.
Define and enforce team-level coding, review, testing, and release standards; align with enterprise frameworks set by Principal Engineers & central architecture.
Roll out CI/CD, trunk-based development, and test pyramid quality gates to reduce production defects.
Drive regular refactoring and targeted modernization to control technical debt and lower long-term operating costs.
Enforce secure SDLC, access control, encryption, and vulnerability remediation across all team workloads.
Collaborate with Cyber, Risk and Architecture teams to maintain audit-ready solutions and PCI DSS compliance for payment systems.
Lead incident response and root-cause analysis for team-owned services; implement permanent stability improvements.
Partner with Product Owners, enterprise architects, payment vendors, and other engineering leads to align cross-team delivery.
Communicate delivery status, risks, and trade-offs to senior stakeholders; escalate blockers with clear resolution options.
Coordinate cross-team dependencies for smooth, predictable card journey releases; escalate long-term architectural gaps to Principal Engineers.
Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications
Proven people management experience leading high-performance engineering teams building enterprise customer systems.
Track record of full-lifecycle delivery (build-release-run) of complex digital products in Agile continuous delivery environments.
Hands-on proficiency with one modern frontend stack (React/Angular/Vue) and one enterprise backend stack (Java/Spring Boot, .NET, Node.js), plus REST & distributed integration patterns.
Strong fundamentals: OO design, SOLID, test strategy, performance tuning and distributed system resilience.
Practical experience building CI/CD pipelines and automated test suites.
Solid grasp of observability, incident management, SLO/SLI frameworks and reliability improvement cycles.
Experience building software under strict data, security, and regulatory compliance rules.
Clear communication with technical and business stakeholders; strong cross-team negotiation & influencing skills.
Bachelor’s in computer science / software engineering or equivalent relevant industry experience.
What additional skills will be good to have?
Background building financial card payment, digital banking, or card servicing platforms.
Legacy card platform modernization experience and third-party payment processor integration.
Hands-on cloud, container (K8s/OpenShift) and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.
Proven record of delivering measurable team improvements: faster delivery cycles, fewer outages, reduced technical debt.

  • Hands-on skill on data waggling / ETL tool. Knowing of Alteryx/Python is an advantage

汇丰保险经纪业务成立于2022年，作为我们在中国内地保险和财富产品分销的经纪渠道。作为汇丰集团的一部分，我们在中国内地致力于通过财富规划服务业务助力人们提高抵御风险能力、为他们自己及其亲人提供保障，实现他们的人生目标。
汇丰保险经纪为“汇丰财富规划服务”客户提供财富规划以及保险经纪服务，是国内首家持有保险经纪和基金销售双牌照的财富管理机构, 帮助客户实现资产多元化布局，也是汇丰集团100%全资持有的子公司，为不同类型的客户提供相关保障计划及财富配置服务。
汇丰财富规划服务作为汇丰全球重点战略项目之一，以客户的需求为中心，提供更灵活的财富配置体验，
通过创新数字解决方案，在客户指定的时间、地点，一对一量身定制资产配置方案。基于您人生不同阶段需求, 我们通过财富规划：
厘清客户需求，搭建财富金字塔
匹配保障性底层资产：精选保险产品，带来健康保障，规划传承
代销优质基金产品*，多元配置资产
产品类型覆盖货币型、债券型、混合型、股票型等；
工作职责
主要工作包括：
拓展与服务于高净值个人客户，运用财富规划理念及数字工具，为高净值客户提供专业全面、量身打造的投资及保险保障等资产配置服务，包括但不限于保障、投资、子女教育、退休计划等；
代理销售精选优质基金产品，产品类型覆盖货币型、债券型、混合型、股票型；为客户提供精选优质代销基金产品，带来高品质投资产品。
通过高质量服务，为客户一对一量身定制财富规划，不断提高客户口碑推荐；
确保个人与团队活动遵守相关法律法规的要求，且符合汇丰的标准和规程。
任职要求
本科或以上学历，财务、商业等或相关专业为佳
3年及以上金融销售和财富管理行业者或其他行业5年以上销售或销售管理经验
善于沟通，较强的人际交往能力及表达能力
积极进取，有自律意识，目标导向、能高效和独立地工作
渴望学习和成长、有事业心，具备创业精神及商业思维及抗压能力
具备较强的中文口头及书面沟通能力
具有基金从业资格、国际金融理财师（CFP）或相关证书（AFP，EFP，CFA等）者优先考虑

jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
JPMorgan aims to be the bank for the innovation economy. As part of Global Corporate Banking, the Innovation Economy team provides corporate banking services globally to high-growth, innovative businesses, ranging from early/growth-stage venture-backed companies to large publicly listed enterprises. We serve verticals including applied tech, biotech, climate tech, disruptive commerce, fintech, internet, software and digital assets. We are seeking an analyst based in China to join the APAC Innovation Economy (IE) team. The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting senior bankers to manage and expand relationships with clients. This role requires good knowledge of the technology sector, regulatory frameworks, and emerging trends to deliver tailored banking solutions and strategic advice.
Job Responsibilities
Client Relationship Management: Work alongside Senior Bankers to onboard and maintain strong relationships with clients across the various tech verticals / sectors.
Industry Expertise: Stay abreast of technological developments and emerging trends. Provide insights on market trends, regulatory changes, and risk management.
Risk & Compliance: Collaborate with internal compliance teams to ensure adherence to policies and regulations.
Business Development: Support Senior Bankers to identify and pursue new business opportunities. Organize and network at industry events and conferences to expand the bank's presence and client base.
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or other related fields
Minimum 1 year of experience in corporate/commercial banking, investment banking, or fintech
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills
Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment and adapt to changing client needs
ABOUT US
J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
About The Team
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.
